captions.detailed: A countertop digital air fryer featuring a matte gray rectangular housing with rounded vertical corners. The front face includes a black control console with a flush display, a central jog dial, and separate start and stop push buttons colored green and red. A large, sliding drawer basket with a black handle and a gray release latch button sits below the control panel. The basket slides out prismatically to reveal a hollow inner cooking chamber.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a digital countertop air fryer with a sliding basket drawer. The main body should have rounded corners, a black front control panel with a digital display, a rotary jog dial, and green/red start/stop buttons. The drawer should feature a front handle with a prismatic release button and slide out smoothly from the hollowed-out main body.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a main body part modeled as a rounded Box, which is hollowed out on the front using a boolean subtraction. Inside, a black control panel is placed with a flush display box, a rotary Cylinder for the jog dial, and small cylindrical start/stop buttons. The drawer basket is constructed from another hollowed-out box attached to a front cover plate, a handle assembly, and a sliding latch button. Prismatic joints are defined for the drawer slide and the latch button, while a continuous joint is used for the rotary jog dial.
